maria: hey team :wave: I accepted the org invite but when I go to https://github.com/redwood-inference I see zero repos. I have two GH emails (maria@gmail.com and maria@redwood.com). Which one did you send the invite to? :thinking:
jordan: we sent the invite to maria@redwood.com. If you accepted with a different account (personal) GitHub can treat that as an outside collaborator. Did you get a "Claim this account" flow or did it just add you?
maria: I clicked the link and it asked to 'claim org account' then redirected to my GH profile. The avatar shows my gmail one though.
sam: quick checks: open your avatar menu -> click "Your organizations" -> click Redwood Inference -> click "People". If it shows you as an outside collaborator you'll see limited repos. Also if org SSO is enforced you need to authorize.
maria: I tried that, under Organizations I only see "Member of 0 organizations" which feels wrong.
liz: can you run `gh auth status` and paste output? also `gh api /user/emails` to see which emails your token is using.
maria: here you go:
```
$ gh auth status
github.com: Logged in to maria@gmail.com (User)
$ gh api /user/emails
[
  {"email":"maria@gmail.com","primary":true,"verified":true},
  {"email":"maria@redwood.com","primary":false,"verified":true}
]
```
jordan: yeah that shows your CLI/email session is tied to the gmail account. The invite was sent to maria@redwood.com so GitHub treats your gmail session as a different account. Two paths: 1) accept invite while signed into the work email, or 2) we can revoke the invite and resend to the gmail account as an outside-collab (less ideal for SSO/Dedicated access).
maria: I do want the org account under my work email. How do I accept as that account? I tried switching accounts in the browser but the invite link kept telling me I'm already a member.
sam: annoying GH UX. Try these steps: 1) Sign out of github.com in your browser. 2) Sign back in with maria@redwood.com (password + 2FA). 3) Visit the original invite link (ops resend if needed). 4) If it still shows zero repos, go to https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/sso and click "Authorize SSO" when prompted.
maria: ok I'll try sign-out/in now.
(onboarding-bot): Invite sent to maria@redwood.com by ops at 2025-11-02T15:04:10Z
maria: signed out and back in with maria@redwood.com, clicked invite, it accepted but still seeing 0 repos. It also showed a banner "You're an outside collaborator" briefly.
jordan: thanks for trying. I just removed the pending invite and resent a fresh one to maria@redwood.com and re-added you to the "product" team. Try the new link in your email.
maria: got it, accepted again and this time my org page shows teams and repos :tada: I had to click "Authorize SSO" on the org page too.
liz: sweet. Last step: add your SSH key to the work account so cloning works. Eg:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "maria@redwood.com" -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_redwood
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_redwood.pub | pbcopy
# paste into https://github.com/settings/ssh/new
```
maria: added key and can clone private repos now. Thanks everyone!
jordan: welcome aboard :tada: ping if any repo perms still look off and we'll fix team mapping.
onboarding-bot: maria has joined the org and was added to team: product. Welcome! :wave:
